ZONINGLOTandLARGESCALEDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This ZONING LOT and LARGE SCALE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), dated as of the 3"d day of November, 2005, by and between CRP/EXTELL PARCEL L, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership having an office c/o Extell Owner"), and CRP/EXTELL PARCEL N, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership having an office c/o Extell Development Company, 800 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10022 (*"Parcel N Owner"; Parcel L/M Owner and Parcel N Owner sometimes WITNESSETH: A. WHEREAS, Parcel L/M Owner is the owner in fee simple of (i) the parcel of land, together with any buildings and improvements situated thereon, located at the intersection of Riverside Boulevard and West 61s Street, as laid out on City Map Amendment ACC No. 30140 dated May 15, 1992 (the “City Map") in the Borough of Manhattan, such parcel of land being more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Parcel L Premises") and (ii) the parcel of land, together with any buildings and improvements situated thereon, contiguous to the Parcel L Premises and located at the intersection of Riverside Boulevard and West 59th Street as laid out on the City Map, such parcel of land being more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Parcel M Premises"; the Parcel L Premises and the Parcel M Premises collectively, the “Parcel L/M Owner Premises"); and B. WHEREAS, Parcel N Owner is the owner in fee simple of the parcel of between West 59"h Street and West 61" Street, as laid out on the City Map in the Borough of Manhattan, such parcel of land being more particularly described on Exhibit C annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Parcel N Owner Premises"); and

C. WHEREAS, the Parcel L/M Owner Premises, the Parcel N Owner Premises, and certain contiguous lands and property to the north, south, east and west of the Parcel L/M Owner Premises and Parcel N Owner Premises, have been designated as a of Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution") pursuant to and subject to the terms of a certain Restrictive Declaration dated as of December 17, 1992 by Penn Yards Associates recorded January 6, 1993 in Reel 1934 Page 1, as amended by that certain First Modification to Restrictive Declaration made as of October 4, 1994 by Hudson Waterfront Associates, L.P. and recorded December 2, 1994 in Reel 2159 Page 1096, as further amended by that certain Second Modification to Restrictive Declaration made as of January 9, 1997 by Hudson Waterfront Associates, L.P. and recorded February 13,1997 in Reel 2422, Page 424; as further amended by that certain Third Modification to Restrictive Declaration made as of September 13, 1999 by Hudson Waterfront Associates, L.P.and recorded January 7, 2000 in Reel 3026, Page 1983; as further amended by that certain Fourth Modification to Restrictive Declaration made as of November 9, 2001 by HudsonWaterfront Associates, L.P. and recorded January 25, 2002 in Reel 3436, Page 1992 as restated by Restated Fourth Amendment to Restrictive Declaration made as of November 9, 2001 by Hudson Waterfront Associates, L.P. and recorded March 15, 2002 in Reel 3470, Page 1813, as same may be amended from time to time as permitted under this Agreement (as so amended, the“Restrictive Declaration"); and D. WHEREAS, the Large Scale Property has been granted certain and is subject to the terms of certain special permits issued pursuant to Sections 74-743, 74-681, 74-99, 13-462 and 74-52 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York approved under ULURP No. C 920358 ZSM on December 17, 1992, which special permits have been modified pursuant to ULURP Nos.
